behaviour.title: Re-running will duplicate rows, despite the node name
behaviour.detail: "Update Drip Status" is named as an update or upsert but runs operation create, which always writes a new record. A redelivered webhook, a manual retry or an overlapping scheduled run therefore creates a second copy. Add a unique key on the destination, or switch the operation, before you rely on it.

behaviour.title: Re-running will duplicate rows, despite the node name
behaviour.detail: "Upsert Harvest into Notion" is named as an update or upsert but runs operation create, which always writes a new record. A redelivered webhook, a manual retry or an overlapping scheduled run therefore creates a second copy. Add a unique key on the destination, or switch the operation, before you rely on it.

behaviour.detail: The from number is +15550100000, which is in the reserved fictional 555-01xx range and is not a number anyone can send from. Twilio rejects it. Put a number on your own account here, or a Messaging Service SID.

behaviour.title: Set a real fallback for the placeholder expressions
behaviour.detail: "ONCALL_NUMBER" appears as the fallback branch of an expression. When the upstream field is missing the expression does not fail - it resolves to that literal string and the call is made with it, which reads downstream as a malformed value rather than as missing data.
